MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 13, 2024
  255 N. MARINA DRIVE
  SEAL BEACH YACHT CLUB, 2:30 PM

Colin Kelly, Chair  Elizabeth Lambe, Commissioner
Jo Murray, Vice Chair  Bruce Mac Rae, Commissioner
Avis Atkins McPhail, Commissioner  Theresa Marino, Commissioner
Elizabeth Carlin, Commissioner  Sabrina Zavala, Commissioner
Gordana Kajer, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  TAMALYN.SAYRE@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-53672  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Marine Advisory Commission
  meeting of Thursday, May 9, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-53693  Recommendation to endorse submission to approve a fee waiver for the Seal
  Beach Yacht Club (SLBYC), in an amount not to exceed $2,160.00, for use of 108
  parking spaces in Alamitos Bay Marina for The Charity Regatta Swap Meet on
  August 3, 2024. (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-53675  Recommendation to receive and file the Manager's monthly oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-53676  Recommendation to receive and file the Committee status reports.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-53673  Recommendation to elect a chair and vice-chair of the Marine
  Advisory Commission, as required by Long Beach code section 2.18.060.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-53674  Recommendation to elect Commission members of the Marine Advisory
  Commission; for Executive, Finance, Maintenance/Operations, and Tidelands
  Capital Projects Committees.

  Page 1 of 2
   MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, JUNE 13, 2024
  255 N. MARINA DRIVE
  SEAL BEACH YACHT CLUB, 2:30 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Marine Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Tamalyn Sayre, Bureau Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Marine Bureau office at (562) 570-3215 by noon
the day prior to the meeting.
